clue.text: Flatbread set alongside small cooking apparatus

explanation.surface: A cook puts some flatbread down beside a little piece of kitchen equipment.

explanation.definitionFit: Rotisseries are spit-roasting devices, a kind of cooking equipment.

clue.text: Couple mostly wearing regular knitted clothing?
